summary: Kensington Capital Acquisition Corp. VI, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K announcing that holders of its units may elect to separately trade the Class 1 redeemable warrants beginning April 24, 2026. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share, one-quarter of one Class 1 warrant, and three-quarters of one Class 2 warrant. Upon separation, new units (one Class A share plus three-quarters of a Class 2 warrant) and Class 1 warrants will trade separately on NYSE under symbols KCA.U and KCAC.W, respectively. No fractional Class 1 warrants will be issued. This is a routine administrative update regarding unit separation, not a special situation event.
